scope: Additive TH18 regular P.E.K.K.A direct-parent baseline. The historically removed Hidden Tesla bonus remains deliberately absent from the shared damage path.
game_version: The pinned public level payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. No consulted source identifies a newer P.E.K.K.A-specific TH18 balance change or a current client build for all parent values.

sources.title: Home Village P.E.K.K.A structured troop record
sources.limitations: The pinned public payload supplies L1-L13 hitpoints, direct damage, cadence, range, movement, housing, target type, level requirements and visual paths. It is not a current version-identified combat specification and supplies no projectile, collision, spell, trap or target-tie contract.

sources.title: P.E.K.K.A
sources.limitations: Community history records the former Hidden Tesla x2 interaction and its 12 October 2016 removal. It does not establish a current client build, a complete current rule set, collision geometry, or fixed-tick ordering.

sources.title: Troop Targeting and AI: Why Your Troops Do That
sources.limitations: The general article describes nearest-building behavior for troops without a preferred target, but does not publish P.E.K.K.A-specific reachability, tie-break, retarget, collision or exact action-order data.

support.note: Core materializes the pinned L1-L13 direct parent baseline through the shared deployment, targeting, movement and damage routes. No P.E.K.K.A-specific Tesla multiplier or retarget priority is enabled; Headless, Viewer and RL consume this same state.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L1-L13 parent despite a generic deployable Core route and a frozen audit excluding the obsolete Tesla interaction.
changed_values.replacement: The existing source-backed direct-parent route is explicitly classified core_supported_secondary_partial and covered by focused snapshot, replay, deterministic hash, Headless CLI and adapter tests.
changed_values.justification: The parent table contains the fields needed for deterministic direct baseline combat. The historical Tesla exception is evidence against adding a special rule, not an authorization for an unverified replacement mechanic.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source provides a current version-identified complete P.E.K.K.A. table or a fixed-tick specification for target acquisition, path selection, equal-distance tie-breaks, retargeting, wind-up, impact, collision, spell stacking or trap interaction.

No consulted source supplies P.E.K.K.A projectile or contact geometry, attack-animation timing, visual scale/animation verification, or a current authoritative confirmation beyond the generic secondary level table.

The former Hidden Tesla x2 interaction is historically removed according to secondary history. No consulted 2026 official release note reintroduces it; the generic shared damage route is deliberately preserved rather than guessing a special modifier.
conclusion: P.E.K.K.A L1-L13 is executable as a direct primary-target baseline through Core, Headless CLI, Viewer and RL, with snapshots, replays and deterministic hashes. The obsolete Tesla multiplier stays disabled. Current numeric fidelity, targeting/pathing chronology, collision, interactions and visual fidelity remain explicitly partial.
